global.on: A place in the header (window) or the floating dock (phone)
global.does: Opens that place. The frame stays where it is; the page changes.

global.on: Back arrow on an account page

global.does: Closes a dialog first; otherwise goes back one page.

global.on: An account row, report card or invite card
global.does: Opens it; in a wide window an account opens beside the list instead.

global.on: A filter chip or the search field
global.does: Narrows the list in place; the count beside each chip is what it would show.
Asks the server again and shows the page loading while it waits.

global.on: Resolve, Dismiss, Suspend, Resume, Revoke, Cancel, Purge, Create
global.does: Runs in place. Anything that changes a person or a session asks first.

global.on: Copy beside an ID or a code
global.does: Copies it and says so in a toast.
Disappear after 3 s; errors stay 5 s and are read out.
Shows the server’s name and a ready dot on every signed-in page. Invites appears only on servers that register by invite.

interactions.does: Every count reads 0, the bars are replaced by one line saying the node has answered nothing yet, and the audit panel says no action has been taken.
